paragraphs.text: Jiwari (jee-WAH-ree) is a kami from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Jiwari is the great kami of earthquakes, whose appearance is always preceded by waves of shinen (“spirit fire”). Jiwari is a huge kami that lives under the surface of the earth. Its appearance is that of an enormous rocky creature with a gigantic maw, with numerous eyes at the end of long, curling earthworm-like appendages.
